title: Bonhoeffer‘s Theory of Stupidity
summary: An animated Sprouts video presenting Dietrich Bonhoeffer's argument that stupidity is more dangerous than evil, because reason cannot reach stupid people. It frames stupidity as a social and moral phenomenon.
why: HN commenters cite it when discussing Bonhoeffer's idea that stupidity is a moral failing rather than an intellectual one.

quote.text: bad morals not low IQ, mind virus social more than individual
